items.title: Presenting my SER poster at ShowCAIS 2026 this Friday
items.summary: I will present "Privacy-Preserving and Sustainable Biomechanical Modeling: Overcoming Data Scarcity in Wearable Sensing" at ShowCAIS 2026 on Friday, March 27, 2026.
items.venue: USC Center for AI in Society, ShowCAIS 2026
body: This poster presents SVD Embedding Regression (SER), a low-rank representation model for wearable biomechanics that is designed to stay practical when data are limited and privacy matters.
The work focuses on privacy-preserving, lightweight modeling under data scarcity while still delivering strong qualitative and quantitative biomechanical estimation results.

I also wanted this part of the site to become a long-term home for updates like posters, talks, and milestones, so future announcements can live here and older ones can move into the archive without getting lost.
